verdict.rationale: Dynadot is a domain registrar, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is a category error for this product type. The evidence shows only that Dynadot publishes its own MCP server for AI assistants to connect to. That is the server role and does not make this client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
